comment:
* A runtime schema for a single protobuf message. A schema provides operations on message instances
 * such as serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: void writeTo(T message, Writer writer) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes the given message to the target {@link Writer}.

methods.name: void mergeFrom(T message, Reader reader, ExtensionRegistryLite extensionRegistry) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Reads fields from the given {@link Reader} and merges them into the message. It doesn't make
   * the message immutable after parsing is done. To make the message immutable, use {@link
   * #makeImmutable}.

methods.name: void mergeFrom(T message, byte[] data, int position, int limit, Registers registers) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Like the above but parses from a byte[] without extensions. Entry point of fast path. Note that
   * this method may throw IndexOutOfBoundsException if the input data is not valid protobuf wire
   * format. Protobuf public API methods should catch and convert that exception to
   * InvalidProtocolBufferException.

methods.name: boolean isInitialized(T message)
methods.comment: Checks whether all required fields are set.

methods.name: T newInstance()
methods.comment: Creates a new instance of the message class.

methods.name: boolean equals(T message, T other)
methods.comment: Determine of the two messages are equal.

methods.name: int hashCode(T message)
methods.comment: Compute a hashCode for the message.

methods.name: void mergeFrom(T message, T other)
methods.comment:
* Merge values from {@code other} into {@code message}. This method doesn't make the message
   * immutable. To make the message immutable after merging, use {@link #makeImmutable}.

methods.name: int getSerializedSize(T message)
methods.comment: Compute the serialized size of the message.

methodNames: void writeTo(T message, Writer writer) throws IOException
void mergeFrom(T message, Reader reader, ExtensionRegistryLite extensionRegistry) throws IOException
void mergeFrom(T message, byte[] data, int position, int limit, Registers registers) throws IOException
